description: This file defines the data transfer object 'HolidayDetailDTO' used to encapsulate holiday and working days details within the loan account portfolio of the Fineract system. It contains properties related to holiday enablement, a list of holidays, working days information, and transaction allowance flags, along with corresponding constructors and getter methods.

classes.name: HolidayDetailDTO
classes.description: Data transfer object for conveying holiday and working days details, including flags for holiday enablement and transaction permissions.

methods.name: HolidayDetailDTO
methods.description: Constructor initializing all properties with provided values, with defaults for transaction permission flags.

methods.name: getHolidays
methods.description: Returns the list of holiday objects.

methods.name: isAllowTransactionsOnHoliday
methods.description: Indicates if transactions are allowed on holidays.

methods.name: isAllowTransactionsOnNonWorkingDay
methods.description: Indicates if transactions are allowed on non-working days.
